evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Hands-on with dbt and dimensional modeling — you build transformation models, write dbt tests, and design star and snowflake schemas from scratch
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Testing and dimensional modeling rigor balance against the 'performance-driven, fun' culture framing and rapid GTM dashboard delivery, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: give GTM teams actionable visibility into revenue KPIs and customer journey metrics
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal GTM/revenue decision-making at a B2B SaaS company without financial-reporting or regulatory-audit language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: lead Data Engineer; GTM Strategy & Insights managers
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role extends an existing dimensional modeling layer and dbt conventions within a named 'GTM Analytics & Insights team', progressively taking ownership as the data foundation grows, indicating a growing but already-established data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Own and extend our dimensional modeling layer — learn our existing dbt models and datamart conventions, then progressively take ownership of new subject area datamarts — designing fact and dimension tables from scratch as the warehouse grows
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (LOD expressions, window functions/CTEs, star/snowflake schema design, dbt tests) that shows exactly what the role does day to day, written by someone close to the work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: give GTM teams actionable visibility into revenue KPIs and customer journey metrics
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves GTM (go-to-market), revenue, and customer-journey stakeholders, a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: progressively taking ownership of new datamart development as our data foundation grows... designing fact and dimension tables from scratch
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines progressive ownership of new datamart design (strategic-leaning) with building specific dashboards and responding to defined stakeholder requirements (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: n8n automation with 'exposure to LLM-driven or agentic patterns' is listed only as a preferred nice-to-have, not a core expectation of the candidate's own workflow or infrastructure output.
evidence.testing_framing: you build transformation models, write dbt tests, and design star and snowflake schemas from scratch
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: dbt tests are named as part of the technical skill set with a concrete verb (write dbt tests), but framed as a requirement/skill rather than a dedicated ownership responsibility, landing as tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in growth, ownership, and culture terms ('play a pivotal role in building the data foundation', 'push each other to new heights') with no risk, compliance, or reliability register present.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: extending our existing dimensional models before progressively taking ownership of new datamart development as our data foundation grows
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes extending existing dimensional models (fix/scale) with designing new fact/dimension tables from scratch for new datamarts (greenfield) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.
